input: n is an integer with 0 <= n <= 9. Integers are plain int values, excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists rather than subclasses; strings are ordinary str values. Standard built-ins are unmodified and no concurrent mutation occurs. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Declared size bounds do not guarantee allocation capacity or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: A fresh list of all valid n-queens boards, each board a fresh list of n immutable strings of length n using only ASCII dot and Q. Every row and column has exactly one Q and no two queens share a diagonal. Boards appear in depth-first order of ascending chosen columns by row, with no symmetry reduction or duplicates. n = 0 returns one fresh empty board.
mutation_aliasing: There is no mutable input. Boolean occupancy arrays and the placement path are private and restored after each recursive choice. Every output board container is freshly allocated and distinct; strings are immutable, so string identity sharing is irrelevant. No board aliases occupancy or placement state. Calls retain no shared mutable state.
numeric: For n <= 9, indices, row + column and row - column + n fit the allocated 2*n + 1 diagonal arrays and are exact integers. The number of complete placements is at most 9! = 362880, safely representable. Helper recursion has at most n + 1 <= 10 live calls. Every string repeat count is nonnegative for a completed placement.
complexity: O(n*n! + R*n*n + 1) time for R solutions, including board-string materialization. The number of partial nonrepeating-column placements is bounded by a constant times n!, and each non-leaf call scans n columns. Auxiliary occupancy/path/stack space is O(n + 1); retained boards occupy O(R*(n*n + n + 1)) storage, including outer and inner containers. The n = 0 empty board is charged. No constant-total-space claim is made.

helpers.name: collect
helpers.contract: A row-by-row recursive closure using column and two diagonal occupancy arrays. Choose one available column, mark all three arrays, append placement, recurse, then undo every change. At row n, materialize a fresh board from the placement.
helpers.cost: The full helper definition is 823 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in source bytes. At most n + 1 live calls; all occupancy checks, reversible writes, string construction and returned board containers are charged.
